name: Priya Nair
text: My brother and I want to buy out a third partner in our print shop. We have no written agreement. Where should we start?

text: I own a small building with two tenants and my leases are ten years old. Can someone review them?

text: After my mother passed I was named executor of her estate. I have the will but do not know what to do first.

text: I was given a severance agreement and have until the end of the month to sign. I would like to understand it before I do.

name: Helen Marsh
text: Looking for the name of a notary. Thank you.
